records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Animal rescue incidents attended by LFB dataset. The dataset covers incidents from January 2009 and the current listed CSV window runs through July 2026. The official page states that incident records include location information including postcode, borough and ward. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official source window; target-row extraction, geometry and parcel join are deferred to local OpenCode.
